{"command": "python - <<'PY'
import requests, secrets
s=requests.Session(); u='quest'+secrets.token_hex(5); p=secrets.token_urlsafe(12); base='http://172.20.0.2'
for path,data in [('/register',{'username':u,'password':p}),('/login',{'username':u,'password':p})]:
 r=s.post(base+path,json=data,timeout=8); print(path,r.status_code,r.text, 'cookies',s.cookies.get_dict())
r=s.get(base+'/profile/ram',timeout=8); print('/profile/ram',r.status_code,repr(r.text))
PY"}
